title: Skill-Space Shooting for Autonomous Robot Policy Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2609.38178v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robots deployed in the physical world must be able to improve beyond their initial training as they encounter new situations and failures. For this improvement to scale across tasks, it must make effective use of experience without requiring human demonstration of each correction. Recent agentic systems offer a way to reduce this reliance on human effort by using foundation models to autonomously compose learned behaviors to complete tasks. Yet completing tasks this way does not itself teach a task policy to overcome its own failures; that requires turning these behaviors into learnable corrections for the policy. Our insight is that many such corrections are familiar short behaviors, or skills: they recur across tasks and describe actions that foundation models can reason about from a scene. We introduce skill-space shooting, which uses foundation model guidance to explore corrections through these reusable skills and turn successful

translated_title: 面向自主机器人策略改进的技能空间打靶法
translated_abstract: 部署在物理世界中的机器人必须能够在遇到新情况和失败时超越其初始训练而持续改进。为了让这种改进能够跨任务扩展，必须有效地利用经验，而无需人类对每次纠正进行示范。近期的智能体系统通过利用基础模型自主组合已学习的行为来完成任务，提供了一种减少对人工依赖的途径。然而，以这种方式完成任务本身并不能教会任务策略克服自身的失败；这需要将这些行为转化为策略可学习的纠正。我们的洞察是，许多这样的纠正是人们熟悉的短行为，即技能：它们在任务间反复出现，并描述了基础模型能够从场景中推理出的动作。我们提出了技能空间打靶法，它利用基础模型的引导，通过这些可复用的技能探索纠正方案，并将成功的经验转化……
tldr: 提出技能空间打靶法，利用基础模型通过可复用的技能来探索策略纠正，使机器人策略无需人类示范即可自主从失败中学习并改进。
en_tdlr: Skill-space shooting uses foundation model guidance to explore policy corrections through reusable skills, enabling robot policies to autonomously learn from failures without human demonstrations.
